decisions.reason: The suggested hosts for a milestone-local review environment do not change the production-security requirement or its security priority.
Hosting the application for client testing does not change the requirement to provide an administrative panel.
The review-hosting platform suggestions concern the separate hosted testing environment and do not alter the required web application target.
Vercel and Heroku are suggested for the hosted review environment; the source does not change the Android application requirement.
Vercel and Heroku are suggested for the hosted review environment; the source does not change the iOS application requirement.
